the new retrofit system is very effective in increasing the ductility and the energy dissipation of the columns.

the new hybridized retrofit method can improve the ductility, strength, stiffness degradation, energy dissipation and the ductility of the retrofitted columns, and can be used in the seismic retrofit of existing RC columns.

the hybridized retrofit method can increase the displacement ductility ratio by 2.2-3.3 times, the stiffness degradation by 2.3-4.2 times, and the energy dissipation by 1.8-3.3times, compared with the original columns.
the hybridized FRP method is an effective and economical method for improving the ductility and strength of reinforced concrete columns.
